name: Ward Needle
description: Loose a needle of venom through the user's own ward so it leaves the guard unbroken.

name: Stinging Ward
description: Hold a ward that stings every hand and blade that presses on it.

name: Ward Taste
description: Taste whatever toxin touches the ward and learn its make before it passes.

name: Warded Bite
description: Bite through a foe's guard with venom while the ward keeps the user unharmed.

name: Venom Canopy
description: Spread a canopy of ward and venom over allies that blunts blows and stings attackers.

name: Ward Cleanse
description: Lift a poison from an ally and fix a ward over the spot so it cannot return.

name: Thorned Barrier
description: Raise a ring of ward-bound barbs that throws a blow's force back as venom.

name: Ward Rupture
description: Burst the ward outward in a sickening shell that leaves allies at the centre untouched.

name: Absorbing Ward
description: Let the ward drink in all the poison and force that touch it and store it for the next strike.

name: Hallowed Venom
description: streams: Poison + Protection; spread a venom that shields allies within its circle while it sickens every foe.

name: Sapling Barb
description: Throw a barbed sapling of venom wood that roots in the target's clothing.

name: Creeper Guard
description: Wind poisonous creepers round the arms to catch a blow and sting the striker.

name: Bark Taste
description: Lay a palm on bark or a wooden hilt and taste the poison worked into it.

name: Strangling Creeper
description: Grow a creeper from the palm that wraps the foe's limbs and drips toxin as it tightens.

name: Spore Haze
description: Shake a haze of venom spores that fogs the foe's mind and scatters their aim.

name: Sap Salve
description: Smear a salve of living sap over an ally's wound so the flesh grows back.

name: Thornroot Spike
description: Thrust a root-hard spike of venom wood through the guard and into the flesh.

name: Poisonwood Bloom
description: Open a great bloom of poisonwood whose pollen stings every foe that breathes it.

name: Thorn Snare
description: Lay a hidden mat of thorn and venom that closes round the first foot to step on it.

name: Drinking Root
description: Sink roots of qi into the body and drink every toxin and blow into green strength.

name: Thousand Thorns
description: streams: Poison + Wood; raise a thicket of venom thorns that pierces and binds every foe in the field.

name: Pall Dart
description: Loose a dart that trails a pall of stilling venom behind it.

name: Pall Cloak
description: Draw a pall of dull grey qi round the body so blows land softly and slow.

name: Pall Taste
description: Taste the hush that death-touched poison leaves in the air and mark its source.

name: Silent Bite
description: Bite with a venom so quiet that the foe feels nothing until the limb falls still.

name: Stilling Mist
description: Breathe a grey mist that stills the heartbeat of all who inhale it for a few moments.

name: Last Remedy
description: Draw a death-touched poison from an ally's blood before it stills the heart.

name: Cessation Cloud
description: Raise a cloud that stops strength, breath and thought in every foe it covers.

name: Quiet Fang
description: Sink a fang whose venom spreads without pain or sound along the foe's spine.

name: Withered Core
description: Wither the heart of the target's qi at its core and pass through hide and ward.

name: Final Venom
description: streams: Poison + Death; give the foe a dose that ends every function of the body and seals the last breath.
